tokens.name: bg-void
tokens.usage: Primary page background — the deep void the whole system sits on. Everything else is read against it.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Container / card fill over bg-void (Obsidian, ~80% opacity) — nav bar, dashboard panels, tiles, note cards.

tokens.name: border-slate
tokens.usage: Hairline container borders (pair with border-hairline). Decorative only — ~1.3:1 against bg-void, below the 3:1 floor for a border that must carry meaning on its own; where a border needs to read as a boundary, pair it with a gold fracture seam (gold-600 + shadow-fracture-glow) instead.

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Warm ivory. Headlines and primary reading copy on bg-void and surface (≈19:1).

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Aged ash. Body copy, captions and metadata on bg-void and surface (6.95:1).

tokens.name: gold-600
tokens.usage: Kintsugi gold, solid. Index numbers, mono labels, small UI text, icons and hover states on bg-void (7.44:1) — the only gold reliable enough to read as text.

tokens.name: gold-100
tokens.usage: Kintsugi gold, light. Gradient highlight stop and glow tint only — not for body text. Pair with gold-600 for the signature seam gradient: linear-gradient(135deg, gold-100, gold-600).

styles.name: hero-title
styles.usage: The hero name/headline. One per page.

styles.name: section-header
styles.usage: Section titles (36–44px band; 40px is the default). Pairs with a mono index label.

styles.name: nav-wordmark
styles.usage: The nav bar wordmark, set in caps via CSS (text-transform), not typed caps.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Running body copy, intros, card descriptions. Set in text-secondary on bg-void/surface.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Index numbers ("01 / WHO AM I?") and metadata labels. All caps via CSS, set in gold-600.

styles.name: nav-link
styles.usage: Nav bar links and small UI controls. All caps via CSS, set in text-primary, gold-600 on hover.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Tight internal gaps — icon-to-label, chip padding.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Internal stack gaps within a card.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Gaps between related elements — card grids, note-card scatter offsets.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Component internal padding, vertical (pairs with space-36 horizontal).

tokens.name: space-36
tokens.usage: Component internal padding, horizontal (pairs with space-32 vertical).

tokens.name: space-64
tokens.usage: Container side margins at max-width (container-max).

tokens.name: space-140
tokens.usage: Vertical gap between major homepage sections.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Standard corner radius for cards, tiles and containers — kept small and "stone-cut"; combine with a clip-path polygon for a jagged/slanted edge on hero and portal cards rather than raising this value.

tokens.name: shadow-elevated
tokens.usage: Elevated surfaces raised off bg-void — cards, panels, the sticky nav.

tokens.name: shadow-gold-glow
tokens.usage: Ambient glow behind an active/hover gold element — tile borders, the nav's live-status node.

tokens.name: shadow-fracture-glow
tokens.usage: Applied as filter: drop-shadow(...) — never box-shadow — on gold kintsugi SVG seam paths and fractured-portrait edges.

tokens.name: border-hairline
tokens.usage: Container hairline border width. Pair with color border-slate.

tokens.name: border-fracture
tokens.usage: Metallic gold fracture-vein border/stroke width. Pair with the gold-100→gold-600 gradient and shadow-fracture-glow.

tokens.name: container-max
tokens.usage: Max content width, centered, with space-64 side margins.
